prompt: Trong các tam thức bậc hai sau, tam thức bậc hai nào luôn âm với mọi <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>ℝ</mi></mrow></semantics></math>?
solution: Tam thức bậc hai <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>f</mi><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn></mrow></semantics></math> có hệ số <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>a</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math> và <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>Δ</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>3</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo>⋅</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>⋅</mo><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>4</mn><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>7</mn><mo><</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></semantics></math> nên luôn âm với mọi <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>∈</mo><mi>ℝ</mi></mrow></semantics></math>.
